title.en: Knights and knaves, as a script

t.zh: 把证明写给人看：假设了什么，推出什么，矛盾在哪里；每一步交给合适的证明助手。
t.en: Write the proof for people: what is supposed, what follows, where the contradiction lies; each step handed to the right proof assistant.

brief.zh: a 说：「b 是无赖。」c 说：「a 和 b 是同一种人。」写一段脚本，证明 c 是无赖。
brief.en: a says: “b is a knave.” c says: “a and b are the same kind.” Write a script that proves c is a knave.

hint.zh: 假设 c 是骑士，他的话就成立。
hint.en: Suppose c is a knight: then what he says holds.

hint.zh: a 和 b 是同一种人，又一个说另一个是无赖：这个矛盾交给证明重建器。
hint.en: a and b the same kind, and one calling the other a knave: hand that contradiction to the reconstructor.
